exact_statement: For every integer m>=1, f_m=2*1[x0=1]*1[at least one xi=1 for 1<=i<=m]-1 on the uniform (m+1)-cube, represented as the union of the m distinct clauses (x0 AND xi), with supports ordered (0,i), M_i=1, pi_i=1/4 and lambda_i=1/m, has exact finite posterior partition weights S_B({0})=1/4, S_B(T)=m^(-t)*(a/4)^t, and S_B({0} union T)=t!*a^(t-1)/(4*m^t)*(1+(1-t/m)*a), where t=|T|>=1 and a=2^(-6/5). Its complete conditioned all-partition residual is <=(43/10) I(f_m), and its exact conditioned all-partition run-cost expectation is <=(23/2) I(f_m). A normalized prior w_k=1/((k+1)(k+2)) on lambda_i^(k)=2^(-k)/m pays at most v additional bits, giving bounds (53/10) I and (25/2) I respectively. Every point-mass posterior choice in this representation has residual/I tending to infinity as m tends to infinity.

exact_statement: For every nonconstant finite Boolean indicator B=OR_l b_l with rho_l=E b_l>0, every r>=1 and every fixed lambda_l>0 with sum lambda_l<=1, let p=2^-r, F=2 A_r B-1 on fresh core coordinates, g=2B-1, v=Var(F), s=sum lambda_l rho_l, D=product(1+p lambda_l rho_l)-1 and delta=log2(D/(p s)). There exist distinct actual partition-forest laws with K=1 when the spectral set meets the core and 1<=K<=|T| otherwise. Their root block equals v log2(s)+v delta+r(E K-v) +E sum_roots log2(1/rho_l), with 0<=r(E K-v)<=p I(g)/2 and v delta<=(log2 e) 2rp E B. Thus normalized common-core rarity overhead is at most (log2 e) I(F), leaving base rarity and all remaining coding costs unpaid. For disjoint private conjunctions rho_l=2^-w_l and Q=product(1-rho_l), E K-v=4p^2 Q(sum rho_l-(1-Q)). All E are unconditioned spectral-weighted sums over nonempty sets; entropy units are bits. A fixed complete-reference scale prior lambda^(j)=2^-j lambda, w_j=1/((j+1)(j+2)) pays v for selecting j=0.
hypotheses: positive fixed incidence weights with sum<=1

exact_statement: For every fixed integer r>=1, let p=2^-r and g_L be the product of m=4^L disjoint signs 1-2 A_L on width-L conjunctions, and F_L=2 A_r(1+g_L)/2-1. In the one-actual-gate representation with lambda=1, M=1 and any full physical coordinate order, the normalized root component is exactly zero. With I_g=2L2^L, its natural rank expectation obeys R(F_L)/I(F_L)>=[(8L-23)/12-r] I_g/(I_g+2r) whenever the right side is positive. The actual complete all-partition nonempty run-cost expectation obeys C(F_L)>=(6/(5 ln 2))[R(F_L)-I(F_L)], so its ratio to influence diverges uniformly over full orders, while H(F_L)/I(F_L)<=4+(1+r)/(p I_g). Moreover balanced tensor-seed activations with the same exactly zero root component preserve any Boolean seed h ratio H(h)/I(h) in the tensor limit; the optimal entropy/influence constant of the zero-root class equals that of unrestricted FEI. This does not assert a bound or obstruction for multiple ordered covers, other gate representations, or all successful repeat-visit queue runs.
hypotheses: r>=1 fixed; L>=2 tends to infinity; m=4^L
one actual gate, lambda=1, one ordered cover equal to the full relevant support
